cards.name: A Stainless Story

effects.printed_clause: Activate only while opponent controls more cards than you.
effects.lua_implementation: The activation condition compares total on-field group counts for both players.

official_references.matched_structure: Evenly Matched uses comparative field-card counts as activation/resolution logic.
official_references.official_effect_text: At the end of the [b]Battle Phase[/b], if your opponent controls more cards than you do: [b]You can[/b] make your opponent [b]banish[/b] cards from their field face-down so they control the same number of cards as you do. If you control no cards, [b]you can[/b] activate this card from your hand.

effects.printed_clause: Send a Stain monster from your Deck or a face-up Stain in your opponent’s Deck to GY as the pre-semicolon action.
effects.lua_implementation: GLOBALFLAG_DECK_REVERSE_CHECK exposes face-up Deck cards; cost selection permits own Deck or only face-up opponent Deck Stain among the five summon-effect codes and sends with REASON_COST.

official_references.matched_structure: Parasite Paracide uses official face-up cards inside an opponent’s Deck and the global reverse-Deck check.
official_references.official_effect_text:
FLIP: Shuffle this card face-up into your opponent's Deck.
If you draw this card after it was added to your Deck by its effect: Special Summon it in Defense Position, [b]and if you do[/b], take 1000 damage. All monsters controlled by the player that Summoned this card by its effect become Insect monsters.

effects.printed_clause: This effect becomes that monster’s effect if it is Normal or Special Summoned.
effects.lua_implementation: The five currently eligible Main Deck Stain summon effects are manually mirrored; no dynamic monster-trigger object is invoked from the sent card. Adversarial re-review confirmed this remains non-exact. Adversarial re-review confirmed this remains non-exact.

official_references.matched_structure: Darklord Eveningstar uses CheckActivateEffect to obtain and execute another card’s target/operation.
official_references.official_effect_text:
2 Level 6 or higher DARK Fairy monsters
Your opponent [b]cannot[/b] [b]target[/b] this card with card effects. [b]You can[/b] only use each of the following effects of "Darklord Eveningstar" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b]. If this card is Fusion Summoned: [b]You can[/b] Set 1 "Darklord" Spell [b]and[/b] 1 "Darklord" Trap from your Deck. ([b]Quick Effect[/b]): [b]You can[/b] pay 1000 LP, [b]then[/b] [b]target[/b] 1 "Darklord" Spell/Trap in your GY; apply that card's activation effect, [b]then[/b] shuffle it into the Deck.

official_references.card_name: Grapha, Dragon Overlord of Dark World
official_references.matched_structure: Grapha, Dragon Overlord of Dark World uses ChangeChainOperation for an effect that becomes another printed operation.
official_references.official_effect_text:
"Grapha, Dragon Lord of Dark World" + 1 DARK monster
[b]When[/b] your opponent activates a monster effect, or a Normal Spell/Trap Card, while you have a card(s) in your hand ([b]Quick Effect[/b]): [b]You can[/b] activate this effect; the activated effect becomes "Your opponent discards 1 card". [b]You can[/b] only use this effect of "Grapha, Dragon Overlord of Dark World" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b]. If this Fusion Summoned card in its owner's control leaves the field because of an opponent's card: [b]You can[/b] Special Summon 1 of your "Grapha, Dragon Lord of Dark World" that is banished or in your GY, [b]then[/b] each player with a hand discards 1 card.

effects.issue: CheckActivateEffect can reproduce activatable Spell/Trap effects, but Omega has no generic API that selects and rebinds an arbitrary monster's Normal/Special Summon trigger, event group, targets, labels, and operation. The Lua manually mirrors only the currently listed Stain monsters. Resolution: enumerate the supported monster names in the printed text and maintain the manual map, or add a core trigger-copy API and replace the hard-coded branches in c245970073.lua.

effects.printed_clause: Banish this card from GY; each player draws 1.
effects.lua_implementation: A GY ignition banishes as cost, requires both players able to draw, then draws one for each.

official_references.matched_structure: Upstart Goblin supplies official draw operation; shared-player draw scripts call Duel.Draw separately for each player.
official_references.official_effect_text: Draw 1 card, [b]then[/b] your opponent gains 1000 LP.

effects.printed_clause: You can only activate 1 "A Stainless Story" per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: Only the card activation uses oath SetCountLimit; the GY effect is intentionally unrestricted by that activation-only sentence.

official_references.matched_structure: Pot of Desires uses an oath-style once-per-card-activation count limit.
official_references.official_effect_text: [b]Banish[/b] 10 cards from the top of your Deck, face-down; draw 2 cards. [b]You can[/b] only activate 1 "Pot of Desires" [b]per turn[/b].

cards.audit_note: Confirmed the existing dynamic summon-effect-copy limitation; the current five eligible Main Deck effects remain explicitly mirrored.
